steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Read the King's message.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

steps.text: Go to 1st floor (2nd floor[US]) of Ardougne Castle in East Ardougne.
Talk to King Lathas.

steps.title: Underground Pass
steps.text: Enter the Underground Pass.
Talk to Koftik at the end of the path.
Use the damp cloth on whichever arrow you brought.
Light your fire arrows.
Equip your bow/lit fire arrows, then stand on the marked tile.
Fire at the guide rope attached to the bridge.
Wait for your character to run across the bridge.
Pick up the plank.
Use a rope on the old spike at the end of the path.
Follow the path.

Find your path across the grid. Keep a record of the path over the grid for Regicide quest.
  • You can use the table on the wiki to save your path.
Pull the lever to the south at the end to continue.
Follow the path. Step on the breaks in the line to avoid traps.
Climb down the well.
Pick the lock to the cell.
Dig the mud.
Cross the ledge.

Reaching the eastern side of the wooden bridge maze.
  • Optional: With 50 Thieving, you can take the shortcut. Avoid the bubbles.
Enter the obstacle pipe to the south.
Pass through the tunnel north of the cage.
Enter the door at the end of the path.
Open the temple doors at the end of the path.
Climb down the well.
Exit the Underground Pass.

steps.title: Tirannwn
steps.text:
Wait for Idris to talk to you.
  • If Idris does not spawn, log out and back in to trigger the scene.
Talk to Idris.
Talk to Morvran.
Activate the lodestone at the end of the path.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth at the end of the path.
Talk to the elf tracker.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth.
Talk to the elf tracker.
Right-click and 'follow' the tracks.
Talk to the elf tracker.
Kill the guard that appears past the dense forest.
Talk to General Hining at the end of the path.

Take 2 barrels.
  • Extra is for Mourning's End Part I.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth.
Read the book.
Pick up the pot to the north.
Use both barrels on the tar south of the elf tracker.
Take some sulphur.
Grind the sulphur.
Use the limestone on any furnace.

steps.title: Sabotage
steps.text: Talk to the Chemist in Rimmington.
steps.warning: The The Big Book of Bangs must be in your inventory.

actions.text: What is naphtha and how do I make it?

steps.text: Use your barrel of tar on the fractionation still outside.

steps.title: Operating the still
steps.text:
Create 2 barrels of naphtha.
  • Increase the tar regulator twice.
  • Wait until the pressure valve is in the green.
  • Increase the pressure valve once.
  • 'Add coal' in 1-2 increments to get the heat valve in the green.
  • When the distillation bar is full, exit the interface.

steps.title: Preparing barrel bomb
steps.text: Grind the quicklime into your pot.
Use ground sulphur on the barrel of naphtha.
Use the pot of quicklime on the naphtha mix.
Use a strip of cloth on the barrel bomb.
Kill and cook a rabbit if you don't have one.
Use a cooked rabbit on the Tyras guard.
Use the bomb on the catapult (not the catapult lever).
Watch the cutscene.
Talk to Lord Iorwerth at the Elf Camp.

steps.title: The lord's message
steps.text: Attempt to enter Ardougne Castle.
Talk to Arianwyn.
Go to 1st floor (2nd floor[US]) of Ardougne Castle in East Ardougne.
Talk to King Lathas.
